1055414123.description: Member's Mark Sweet as Pie oval paper plates are crafted from cut-resistant, BPI commercially compostable paperboard, ensuring durability and environmental responsibility. Measuring 10 inches by 12 inches, these plates provide ample space for hearty Thanksgiving meals and are microwave-safe for reheating leftovers. Each pack contains 50 plates, making them perfect for festive gatherings.

1055414124.description: Introducing the Member's Mark Premium White 3-Ply Dinner Napkins, the epitome of elegance and a must-have for effortless entertaining. Crafted from ultra-premium quality, thick tissue paper, these 3-ply napkins are wonderfully soft and highly absorbent, adding a touch of sophistication to your table décor. Softer than standard paper napkins, they pair beautifully with our Member's Mark Premium Plastic Heavyweight Plates at any party or gathering.

1055414125.description: Member's Mark Half Size Aluminum Steam Table Pans are great to have on hand for serving large groups, baking, or prepping food in something sturdy and disposable. Whether you're setting up a buffet for a party, cookout, or team event, these heavy-grade aluminum pans help you prep, serve, and clean up fast.

1055414126.description: 325 members put these bags through the realities of home life like trash day, kitchen cleanups and weekend projects.

1055414127.description: Member's Mark® 1-Ply Everyday White Napkins are perfectly soft for hands and mouths while still being durable enough to tackle unexpected messes at mealtimes. These excellent napkins are ideal for any home or business and are value-sized to last longer than most.

1055414128.description: Feeding a crowd becomes a breeze with the Member's Mark Clear Cutlery Combo Pack. This pack includes 360 pieces of durable, heavyweight plastic cutlery that are designed for long-lasting use. The set is comprised of 180 forks, 120 spoons, and 60 knives, ensuring that you have ample quantity for any event or gathering.

1055414129.description: The Member's Mark unbleached parchment paper is the same great quality you've come to love with the added benefit of being made from 100% unbleached fibers. Oven safe up to 420°F, Member's Mark Parchment Paper seals in nutrients and enhances your food's natural flavor.

1055414130.description: Reynolds Kitchens Slow Cooker Liners help take the mess out of slow cooking by making cleanup a snap. Cook tasty chili, scrumptious game-day meatballs or warm, delicious soups. Get adventurous and try making breakfast or dessert in the slow cooker too! The slow cooker-safe, BPA-free* material does not affect the cook time or taste of the food.

1055414131.description: Bring hassle-free elegance to your table with Member's Mark™ White Tissue Poly Tablecloths. Sold in packages of ten, these Member's Mark disposable tablecloths are perfect for your next event or to have at home ready for when guests arrive.

1055414132.description: Member's Mark Party Set with 2 Hour Safe Heat Chafing Fuel is perfect for serving buffet style, professionally catered events or home entertaining like graduation parties, tailgating, family celebrations, holiday gatherings and more. The sets are disposable/recyclable for easy cleanup.

1055414133.description: Member's Mark™ brings to your table a pack of 12 Count Heavyweight Plastic Serving Tongs, designed meticulously to offer practicality, durability, and sophistication all in one package. Ideal for catered events, parties, barbecues, or everyday home use, these tongs make serving an absolute breeze.

1055414134.description: Member's Mark Ultra Paper Bowls are designed to handle a variety of meals with ease. Featuring a generous 20-oz. capacity, these bowls are perfect for serving hearty soups, stews, pastas, salads, and more. Crafted with a grease-resistant and cut-resistant design, along with advanced soak protection, they ensure no leaks, spills, or soggy bottoms, even with the messiest or most liquid-heavy dishes.

1055414136.description: The Gourmet Breakfast Playset is the perfect addition to any child's play kitchen. Available in two charming color options, pink or white, this two-color assortment is designed to delight kids aged 3 and older. With realistic electronic toy appliances and accessories, this set inspires hours of imaginative pretend play.

1055414137.description: This exciting multi-level rocket features interactive play areas, opening compartments, astronauts, vehicles, and space-themed accessories that inspire endless adventures beyond the stars.

1055414138.description: Dive into a world of fun with 2.2 lbs (1kg) of compound, featuring Butter and Clearz slimes. Enjoy a delightful mix of scents, ranging from sweet cotton candy to tangy blue raspberry, making every play session a sensory treat.

1055414139.description: Let her imagination soar with this 25-piece playset, designed to inspire hours of creative play. This set includes an 18-inch American Girl Truly Me doll, perfect for styling and accessorizing to her heart's content.

1055414140.description: Even the grumpiest holiday humbugs will find it hard to resist the charm of the Dr. Seuss The Grinch Jumbo Plush toy. Inspired by the beloved classic, "How the Grinch Stole Christmas!," this 40-inch plush is perfect for cozy snuggles, festive family movie nights, and spreading holiday cheer.

1055414141.description: Add a touch of whimsy to your nursery or playroom with these aesthetically pleasing rocking animals. Designed to captivate little ones and complement any decor, these rockers are as stylish as they are fun.

1055414142.description: Build the impossible with Air Toobz, a unique STEM toy gift for kids! With tubes that twist and turn any way imaginable and airflow that adjusts from a breeze to a gale, the Air Toobz play system sparks the imagination as much as it instills a core sense of the scientific method.

1055414143.description: Bring the magic of Hogwarts to life with the exclusive Harry Potter x Care Bears Plushies Collectors Set! These enchanting plushies are designed with inspiration from the four iconic Hogwarts Houses, each dressed in their Quidditch robes and holding broomsticks. Perfect for fans of all ages, these plushies combine the charm of Care Bears with the wizarding world.

1055414144.description: The Yvolution Glider Air scooter is the ultimate choice for kids eager to enhance their scooter skills while enjoying a smooth and controlled ride. Crafted with young adventurers in mind, this scooter combines fun and functionality to deliver an unforgettable riding experience.

1055414146.description: For the first time in more than a decade, Topps Flagship Football returns with a fully licensed release, marking the return of one of the most iconic brands in The Hobby.

1055414149.description: Relive favorite moments from Monster Trucks Live with an 8-pack of 1:64 scale toy trucks. Just like the real-size trucks, the Hot Wheels Monster Trucks have unique and outrageous personalities that inspire epic smashing and crashing. Create destructive stories with characters such as Gunkster, Tiger Shark, Rhinomite or Bone Shaker, or let this multipack be an introduction to all the action that Monster Trucks has to offer. Colors and decorations may vary.

1055414151.description: The Pop essence of the new Maison's DNA, is the main inspiration for this collection. The fresh colors together with the silicone material create a perfect timepiece, enriched by an IP Yellow Gold Medusa and Greca. An additional fashion element is the silicone pouch in matching color.

1055414152.description: The Simpli-Magic 16 Gallon Dual Compartment Step Trash Can is thoughtfully designed to streamline kitchen cleanup. Featuring spacious 40L and 20L compartments, this unit allows you to separate waste and recycling effortlessly, making it ideal for busy households that prioritize organization and sustainability.

1055414153.description: Unleash your inner explorer with the National Geographic Ultimate Gemstone Dig Kit! This kit features an extra-large dig brick packed with over 100 genuine gemstone specimens, offering hours of hands-on fun and discovery. Perfect for young geologists, this set provides an exciting way to uncover treasures like agate, quartz, amethyst, tiger's eye, jasper, and more.

1055414154.description: The Member's Mark Women's Sandwash Straight Pant is made from an ultra-soft yet durable fabric that delivers a smooth, lived-in feel for all-day comfort. Designed with a relaxed straight-leg silhouette, functional on-seam pockets, and satin elastic tape at the side seams, it offers a subtle elevated detail while providing flexible comfort and ease of movement. The soft self waistband with elastic side seams ensures a flattering fit that moves with you throughout the day. Easy to dress up or down, it pairs seamlessly with the Member's Mark Snap Funnel Top for a polished, coordinated look, or with casual tees and sweatshirts for everyday wear. Ideal for errands, lounging, or relaxed weekends, this pant is a versatile must-have for effortless comfort and style.

1055414155.description: Reynolds Wrap Every Day 12" Aluminum Foil has a long history of being the ideal everyday solution for storing, prepping, and cooking food. It is easy to rip, easy to use, and easy to store.

1055414156.description: Bring joy and imagination to your child's playtime with the Member's Mark Indoor Play Tent with Mat, available exclusively at Sam's Club. This playful tent is perfect for endless fun, whether it's for reading, imaginative adventures, or simply relaxing.

1055414157.description: Bring the party to playtime with the KidKraft Llama Pinata Building Bricks Table. This vibrant wooden activity table features a building brick surface and comes with 50 large-sized blocks, perfect for constructing imaginative projects. When playtime is over, all the pieces can be conveniently stored in the llama's belly. To retrieve the pieces, simply twist the llama's tail and the bottom opens up to release everything in a fun and exciting manner.

1055414158.description: Spread holiday cheer with the Member's Mark 12' LED Merry Christmas Banner. Perfect for rooflines, windows, and entryways, this vibrant banner features 115 color-changing LED lights that are sure to capture attention and add a touch of brightness to your seasonal decorations.

1055414159.description: The Member's Mark Men's Sandwash Quarter Zip Pullover delivers all-day comfort with ultra-soft, durable fabric and a smooth, lived-in feel. Designed with an oversized yet comfortable fit, it features a mock neck with a quarter-zip for adjustable coverage and a refined fine rib texture for an elevated look. An enlarged kangaroo pocket with a hidden security zipper adds functional storage, while self-fabric cuffs and waistband enhance comfort and durability. Part of the Member's Mark Sandwash Collection, this versatile pullover pairs easily with the Member's Mark Sandwash Pant, tees, joggers, or straight-leg pants—making it ideal for everyday wear, lounging, errands, or casual weekends.

1055414160.description: This boys' full-zip GAP fleece hoodie is the perfect blend of style and comfort, making it an everyday essential for school, play, or layering. Its midweight fleece construction offers a smooth exterior and a brushed interior, providing cozy warmth without feeling bulky.

1055414161.description: Upgrade the look and organization of your garage with the Bold 3.0 Series.

1055414162.description: Everything leaves a trace on your clothes – from the delicious meals you indulge in, to the places you visit, and the activities you partake in. Often, the dirt, grime, and body soils that accumulate on your garments aren't immediately visible to the naked eye. However, just because you can't see them doesn't mean they aren't present. Tide Power PODs Hygienic Clean Laundry Detergent is expertly formulated to tackle this issue by delivering a deep clean that reaches down to the microscopic level.

1055414163.description: Enjoy refreshing pebble ice in as little as 6 minutes! Perfect for soft drinks, juices, cocktails, and more, this ice maker features a 1.5-liter tank that produces enough ice to keep the party going.

1055414164.description: Stay protected from the elements without compromising on style with this DKNY quilted puffer coat. Designed with DKNY's signature matte stretch and water-resistant fabric, this coat offers effortless comfort and functionality for your busy lifestyle.

1055414165.description: Stay cozy without compromising on style with this versatile mid-weight sweater. Perfect for transitional weather and cooler days, it offers the ideal balance of warmth and breathability. The full zip-up front ensures easy wear, making it a convenient choice whether you're heading out, running errands, or relaxing at home.

1055414166.description: A study in timeless design, the Versace Anteo Chrono features a radiant sunray dial, Versace signature engraved on the bezel and Medusa at 12H. The classic five-link bracelet adds a refined finish, creating a watch defined by enduring style.

1055414167.description: Experience the perfect blend of warmth and style with the Land's End Sherpa Pull Over. Crafted from 100% Polyester Sherpa, this pull over is designed to keep you comfortable and cozy during the cooler months, making it an essential addition to your wardrobe.

1055414170.description: The Member's Mark Pre-Lit Prismatic Sleigh is a stunning centerpiece for your festive display. Standing at an impressive 48 inches tall, this decoration is designed to captivate attention and elevate your holiday ambiance. Its iridescent PVC construction reflects light beautifully, creating a dazzling prismatic effect that adds charm to any setting.

1055414171.description: Transform your holiday display with the Member's Mark 76" Pre-Lit Color-Changing Buck, available exclusively at Sam's Club. Standing tall at just over 76", this stunning buck features a sturdy metal frame and a light motion collar, making it a captivating centerpiece for your seasonal decorations.

1055414172.description: Transform your home into a festive wonderland with the Member's Mark LED Candy Cane Rope Light. Featuring warm white LED bulbs and a red and white striped design, this rope light creates a unique candy cane effect that adds charm and cheer to your holiday gatherings.

1055414173.description: Transform your festive celebrations with the Member's Mark Pre-Lit Gingerbread House, a stunning 10-foot holiday statement piece available exclusively at Sam's Club. Adorned with charming details like two candy canes, a peppermint, and frosting accents along the roofline, this gingerbread house creates a magical atmosphere. With a 6-foot entry clearance, it welcomes even your tallest guests with ease.

1055414174.description: Transform your home into a winter wonderland with the Member's Mark 18FT Color Sync LED Snowflake Lights. Featuring 10 dazzling snowflakes measuring 10 inches and 120 micro-LED wire lights per strand, these lights add a touch of elegance and brightness to your holiday decorations. Perfect for rooflines, windows, and overhangs, they create a magical ambiance that will captivate everyone.

1055414175.description: Transform your yard into a winter wonderland with the Member's Mark Pre-Lit Peppermint Lawn Stake, Set of 5. These vibrant peppermints feature an iridescent glitter finish that adds a touch of sparkle to your holiday decorations. Perfect for both indoor and outdoor use, they bring a cheerful glow to any space.

1055414176.description: Transform your yard into a festive wonderland with the Member's Mark 6' Pre-Lit Festive Flamingo, available exclusively at Sam's Club. Standing tall at 6 feet, this cheerful flamingo is crafted with vibrant pink material and topped with a bright red Santa hat. Its playful design, standing firmly on one leg, is sure to spread holiday cheer to everyone who sees it.

1055414177.description: Add a touch of holiday cheer to your outdoor space with the Member's Mark 8-Count Gumdrop Pathway LED Lights. Featuring 8 sugared gumdrop stakes in vibrant red, teal, pink, and green, these whimsical 11.6" lights are perfect for creating a colorful and festive atmosphere. Exclusively available at Sam's Club, they are sure to brighten up your holiday season.

1055414178.description: The Member's Mark Pre-Lit 8 FT. Pop Up Microlight Tree with Star is a stunning addition to your holiday décor. Standing tall at 8 feet, this showstopper is designed to make a statement in your yard or home. With over 4,000 lights, it creates a dazzling display that will captivate everyone.

1055414179.description: Transform your home into a holiday masterpiece with this stunning light string featuring 8 emerald-cut multi-colored "jewels." Each jewel shines in Fuchsia, Peridot, Blue, Red, Blush, Orange, Green, and Classic White, creating a dazzling display that captures the spirit of the season.

1055414182.description: Stock up on the Member's Mark Premium White Napkins (2-ply, 660-count) for your next event. These absorbent napkins help clean up messes and protect surfaces from spills while offering a soft touch and feel.

1055414183.description: Packaged conveniently for foodservice professionals, the Member's Mark® White Plastic Forks (600 ct.) are suitable for nearly any dining environment—parties or events, takeout restaurants, kids' lunch boxes, outdoor eating, road trips and much more.

1055414184.description: Don't worry about having enough utensils at your next celebration with these Member's Mark™ White Plastic Spoons (600 ct.). They feature sturdy, heavyweight construction to prevent breakage. These plastic serving spoons are also perfect for everyday use.

1055414185.description: Embrace stress-free celebrations and forget about shattered glass accidents with these sturdy and stylish cups.
